lines.en: I call up Noriko first thing in the morning and allow her to talk me into accompanying her to some record store so she can force me to listen to music I don’t like.
lines.zh: 一大早我就给 Noriko 打了电话，任由她说动我陪她去一家唱片店，好让她硬塞给我一堆我不喜欢的音乐。

lines.en: It’s not the most exciting of plans I have made, but it gives us the opportunity to spend the morning together, and we don’t get to do that very often.
lines.zh: 这不是我制定过的最激动人心的计划，但它给了我们共度一个上午的机会，而我们并不常有这种机会。

lines.en: Thankfully, the shop she wants to visit isn’t too far away, so the two of us meet up near my house and take a short bus ride over to a shopping plaza she used to visit with her sister all the time.
lines.zh: 好在她想去的店不算太远，于是我们在我家附近碰头，坐了一小段巴士，去到她以前常和姐姐一起逛的一家购物广场。

lines.en: Unfortunately, Niki doesn’t have time for things like that anymore. So the responsibility falls on me as the older brother slash guy she masturbates to to carry the torch and come in her place.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，Niki 已经没有时间做这种事了。于是这份责任就落在了我头上——作为哥哥兼她打飞机时想着的男人，我得接过火炬，顶替她的位置。

lines.en: And while I might have poked fun at the type of music she’s interested in just seconds ago, I will admit that it is a little fun to watch her get excited about things.
lines.zh: 虽然就在几秒前我还在取笑她感兴趣的那类音乐，但我得承认，看她为一些事兴奋起来还挺有意思的。

lines.en: Even if those things cause my ears a great deal of both distress and pain.
lines.zh: 即便那些东西给我的耳朵带来了大量的痛苦与折磨。

lines.en: We’re only in the record store for about forty-five minutes or so, so we wind up heading over a nearby brunch place to cap off the morning afterward.
lines.zh: 我们在唱片店里只待了四十五分钟左右，于是后来转战附近一家早午餐店，为这个上午收尾。

lines.en: Noriko orders a bunch of weird sounding vegetarian food and I just get french toast because I don’t want to hear her talk about how animal cruelty is wrong.
lines.zh: Noriko 点了一堆听名字就很怪的素食，我只点了法式吐司，因为我不想听她讲虐待动物有多么不对。

lines.en: Surprisingly enough, the opposite happens when she tells me that I don’t have to worry about appeasing her and that I’m free to eat whatever I want.
lines.zh: 出人意料的是，情况恰恰相反——她告诉我，我不用担心照顾她的感受，想吃什么就吃什么。

lines.en: And so when the waitress returns, I order a side of bacon as well and the morning ends with me getting at least one thing for myself.
lines.zh: 于是等女服务员回来时，我加了一份培根，这个上午便以我至少为自己争取到一样东西而结束。

lines.en: Two, counting Noriko. But I’ve apparently already had her for years without even knowing it.
lines.zh: 两样，如果把 Noriko 也算上的话。不过显然，我早就在不知不觉中拥有她好多年了。
Noriko 的好感度提升到了 [noriko_love]!
